   **Bugs and stability.**
      12 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Nov 5, 2026 - Nov 18, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _PixelRo_, Nov 18, 2026, 3/5: "Update : The glitch preventing signing in has been fixed - can now use app again to check in. - could we get a simple slide gesture or button to check in a guest from the QR page? The QR page has a button to Refer a Friend but a treasure hunt buried below the fold of the home page to actually check in a friend. Would love a button or feature right there at QR code to also check in a friend. - same points exist about focus of content. Update: Stonewalled after update After updating, only screen that opens is to Creat Profile. Not a single field accepts input. Delete so, reinstall, try from other networks - nothing works. No matter what name is added, error tells you name requirements. Unable to save - forced to check in with desk clerk using phone number for the past week. —- Separately: • Wish app had option to open straight to QR code avoiding the need for navigation friction. • Wish the app had a slide feature from member QR code so you can slide over to guest QR code. Without it checking in guest is a hunt. If you check guest in you can slide over to member QR code, but why not the reverse. • Like that you can view membership details, checking history and such. Strongly dislike the marketing, ptomotions, partner push of the app."
